claims.statement: verify_jwt_signature is located inside app/auth/jwt_verify.py around line 44.
The JWT from the Authorization header is decoded by verify_jwt_signature.
verify_jwt_signature calls the token parser with algorithms=["HS256", "none"], thereby accepting the none algorithm.
When the algorithm header is none, verify_jwt_signature skips signature verification entirely and returns the embedded claims.
verify_jwt_signature has no allowlist of trusted issuers.
Sending Authorization: Bearer with an unsigned admin token to demo-v1 returns an admin session, achieving full account takeover with no secret.
